Coupling journal retention to replacement/removal of the mutable request changes the journal bytes and fails against the preserved prefix.
Losing the stored refusal reason when the request file disappears fails the independent literal reason.
Ignoring a corrupt append rather than assigning its measured gap unknown makes this positive-duration check fail.

Breaking the follower invocation produces a nonzero CLI exit; this is invocation evidence rather than receipt-specific coverage.
Recording JSON output as pane delivery, or failing to record the owning text pane, breaks the deliberately opposing two-parameter cases.

assertion_independence: No tautological self-comparison was found. The injected PID return check at line 361 only verifies passthrough and is not counted as receipt durability; line 213 uses an implementation capacity constant but line 207 independently checks the literal ceiling. Direct helper calls in the lifecycle fixture do not prove production wiring; the two findings and durability justification account for that limitation.

findings.text: The review_record_written receipt is emitted only by _write_record, but composed reviewers are instructed to write their declared JSON file directly; recovery_review_delivery.py:50-86 accepts those files without this wrapper, and review_records.py:2392 reconciles foreign files without stamping this receipt. Such a completed review either has no write instant or first receives one when a later promotion copies it through _write_record, assigning the intervening queue wait to review execution. Observe the actual delivered-file completion, retaining its write time, and cover that path instead of calling the wrapper directly in the lifecycle fixture.

The non-paired predecessor check accepts any earlier stage in the whole run. After review A has recorded review_requested, suppress review_requested for review B and retain B admission/start/write: review_admitted is not paired to a request identity, so A request satisfies B admission and the missing interval is assigned to review_record_written instead of unknown. Request receipts use a head identity while admission receipts use a reviewer run identity, so the relationship needs an explicit association; add a second-round suppression case to protect the negative-control contract.
